levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Grid is missing entries for one or more systems, or entries are too vague to place on a specific day.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Grid includes at least one specific, dated entry for each of the five systems across the week.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Grid includes specific entries for all five systems and reflects genuine upcoming commitments for the actual capstone week rather than placeholders.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Learner does not determine whether any day is overloaded, or miscounts the commitments on a day.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Learner correctly identifies whether any day has three or more different-system demands and, if so, names a specific item to move.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Learner correctly identifies overload, moves a specific item to a specific lighter day, and explains why the new day works better.

lookFors: A grid entry specific enough to check for a real time conflict, a named action on a named day, not a vague label like 'stuff to do.'
An overload determination that is actually verified by counting entries per day, not just asserted without evidence.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
